settings.local_lib.backup.title: Backup & Restore
settings.local_lib.backup.hint: Whenever a gallery's vectors are computed, or its metadata is edited, a [arcid]_zinglib_metadata.json is written under .zinglib_meta in the library root (visual vectors, text vector, read history, hand-picked metadata). This can write those backups back into the database, so a migration or a database rebuild does not force a full recompute.
settings.local_lib.backup.preview_note: This is a preview; nothing has been written to the database yet.
settings.local_lib.backup.summary: {total} galleries in total: {matched} matched a backup, {restored} restored.
settings.local_lib.backup.vectors: {visual} visual vectors · {text} text vectors · {history} history rows · {meta} metadata blocks
settings.local_lib.backup.missing_title: Missing ZingLib-specific metadata, not restored (must be recomputed): {n}
settings.local_lib.backup.orphan_title: Backups whose gallery is no longer in the library: {n}
settings.local_lib.backup.none: No gallery backups exist yet. Finish one embedding pass first.
settings.local_lib.backup.restarting: Automatic embedding was paused for the restore. The service is restarting to bring it back -- refresh the page in a few seconds.
settings.local_lib.writeback.hint: Writes the database's titles and tags back to disk: ComicInfo.xml (Komga / LANraragi read it too) plus the .zinglib_meta backup. For a library imported by another tool, or restored after a rebuild, this is what puts the metadata onto the files so a later scan does not read stale values.
settings.local_lib.writeback.preview_not: Preview first: nothing is written until you confirm, and writing cannot be undone.
settings.local_lib.writeback.preview: Will write back {total} galleries (skipping {skipped} rows with no writable path).
settings.local_lib.show_jpn_title_hint: Show the Japanese/kanji title: the first of Title / Series / AlternateSeries that actually contains kanji or kana. If none of them does, only Title is shown (AlternateSeries is not necessarily Japanese, so a romanized name is never promoted to the title). When off, Title/Series is used.
settings.local_lib.use_translated_tags_h: Splits the ComicInfo.xml Tags field and looks each entry up in the translation table; matches show the translation, everything else is kept as-is. Toggling this rewrites the tags of the whole library.
settings.local_lib.save_db_failed: Saved to JSON, but the database write failed: {reason}
settings.local_lib.save_not_persisted: Setting was not persisted: the value read back differs from the submitted one. Check the database connection.
settings.local_lib.translation.title: Tag Translation Table
settings.local_lib.translation.hint: Upload your own JSON word list. Translated tags are looked up in this table and shown translated when matched. After uploading, click "Re-apply tags" to rewrite the library.
settings.local_lib.translation.missing: No table uploaded; tags are shown as-is
settings.local_lib.reapply.tip: Re-matches and overwrites the tags stored in the database using the current table (both raw and translated forms are recomputed). With a large library this takes a while, so stay on the page and avoid running a scan or a bulk tag edit at the same time.
settings.local_lib.reapply.table_changed: The table changed, but the stored tags have not been recomputed yet. Click "Apply now" to rewrite the library.
settings.local_lib.reapply.pending_hint: {n} works still hold tags from an earlier table.
settings.local_lib.reapply.cancelled_hin: Update cancelled: the {updated} finished entries were kept, {pending} are still pending and can be resumed later.
settings.local_lib.reapply.cancelled_not: Finished blocks are never rolled back; running it again continues from what is left.
settings.local_lib.reapply.cancel_reques: Cancellation requested; stopping at the current entry…
settings.local_lib.reapply.skipped_no_so: {n} works have no usable source tags (no ComicInfo.xml, or raw tags were never recorded) and were skipped; rescan or complete the ComicInfo.xml files and retry.
settings.local_lib.reapply.dialog_warnin: The tags stored in the database are being rewritten from the table. Please stay on the page and do not run a scan or a bulk tag edit at the same time, or the data can end up inconsistent. You can cancel midway; finished entries are kept.
settings.local_lib.reapply.dialog_leave_: Leaving the page does not stop the job; progress keeps showing in the top bar.

settings.local_lib.display_mode.infinite: Loads the next batch as you reach the bottom -- best for browsing continuously.
